caption: The drawing depicts two separate embroidered textile samples on a plain, off-white background, each pinned or placed for display. The upper sample is a small rectangular piece of fabric with a cross-stitched image of a brown deer, facing right, with light brown antlers and dark brown legs. To the left of the deer is a stylized flower with pink petals, red accents, a white central area, and green leaves and stem. The lower sample is a larger, horizontal strip of fabric featuring three cross-stitched floral motifs connected by a looping green vine. The leftmost motif consists of six red circular flowers with green leaves, the center motif is a large pink and red flower with green stem and leaves, and the rightmost motif is a symmetrical design with blue and red elements, also with green leaves. Both fabric pieces have a beige or light brown background, showing the weave of the material. The name "Esther Markinhale" appears lightly in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
